security_spec.violation_condition: XiangShan LSU (Load-Store Unit) applies sstatus.UBE-based byte reordering to data accesses using only the UBE bit value without qualifying by current privilege mode (priv_mode != U-mode), causing S-mode or M-mode data accesses (including page table walks, kernel memory operations, and I/O) to be byte-swapped when sstatus.UBE=1. Conversely, if instruction fetch endianness logic checks UBE, instruction bytes in U-mode would be incorrectly swapped, violating the spec mandate that instructions are always little-endian.
security_spec.summary: sstatus.UBE applied without privilege-mode gating corrupts S/M-mode data accesses or instruction fetches, breaking hardware privilege isolation
